description: Covers B45, B47 and the fetch flakes found 2026-11-03. Adopt push-only triggers, pass markers and the changes job for the core's proxy and harness-windows jobs in ci/gates.yml.in (B45); a bounded retry and an actions/cache of the pinned downloads through a new proxy/tools/netfetch.py and a {{wsc fetch_cache}} render block, without editing a DLL input; a wsc ci check-settings verb that reads branch protection and rulesets with gh api and names the missing required checks and auto-merge settings (B47).
title: The core's CI: pipeline economies and a settings check
